About Mozart / Revenue, reconciled.

Mozart Financial is an AI-powered deduction recovery platform that recovers retailer deductions and reconciles the results for consumer brands selling through retailers and distributors.

From the first deduction to the final accounting entry. We handle the process. Your team stays in control.

Meet Mozart ↗
01 / ABOUT MOZART

What Mozart does

01 /

Deduction identification

Mozart brings retailer, accounting, and ERP records together to identify deductions and connect them to the right invoices. Your team gets a clear view of what needs attention instead of searching across portals and spreadsheets.

02 /

Evidence and appeal preparation

Our agents gather the supporting records, flag missing evidence, and prepare an appeal. Each case stays connected to the documents behind it, making the recommendation easier to review.

03 /

Retailer portal workflows

With authorized access and your approval, Mozart handles appeal submission and follow-up in supported retailer portals. Your team decides whether to proceed; the repetitive portal work stays with Mozart.

04 /

Accounting and recovery reconciliation

Mozart connects the recovery back to the deduction and the relevant accounting records. Approved updates help keep your books aligned with the outcome, rather than leaving recovered money to be reconciled by hand.

02 / ABOUT MOZART

What makes Mozart different

A connected recovery workflow, with judgment in your hands.

01

One workflow, from deduction to books

Identification, evidence, appeals, follow-up, and accounting belong in one connected workflow. Mozart’s approach keeps the outcome tied to the original case so the handoff does not end at a successful appeal.

02

Two clear choices: yes or no

Your team approves or declines the proposed action, while Mozart handles the surrounding work. Approval remains attached to the action so you retain financial control.

03

Evidence you can follow

A recommendation should come with its supporting records, not just a confidence score. Mozart keeps the evidence, decision, and outcome together so your team can understand what happened.

04

Recovery-linked commercial terms

Where contingency pricing is agreed, fees apply to attributable recoveries as defined in your service agreement. The rate, billing basis, and cancellation terms are agreed before paid work begins.

05

Fit your existing finance workflow

Connect the records and systems your team already uses, with access you control. We confirm integration and retailer coverage during setup so the scope is clear before work begins.

Explore the alternatives: Glimpse’s product page · HighRadius’s product page. Compare capabilities and commercial terms for your own workflow.

Who uses Mozart

Designed for the people responsible for turning short payments back into revenue.

  • Lean finance teams currently coordinating deduction recovery through spreadsheets, email, and retailer portals.

05 / ABOUT MOZART

Frequently asked questions

What is Mozart Financial?

Mozart Financial is an AI-powered deduction recovery platform for consumer brands selling through retailers and distributors. It connects dispute identification, evidence, appeals, and accounting in one workflow.

Does Mozart replace our finance team?

No. Mozart handles repetitive recovery work while your team retains control of financial actions. Your team approves or declines what Mozart proposes.

Which accounting and ERP systems can we connect?

We confirm the right connections based on the systems your team uses. Contact us with your accounting, ERP, and retailer setup to establish the supported scope.

How does pricing work?

Pricing and any contingency rate are defined in your service agreement before paid work begins. Where contingency pricing applies, the agreement specifies which attributable recoveries are billable.

How quickly can we get started?

Setup depends on retailer access, integration availability, and the quality of the records available. We agree the onboarding steps and timing with you before work begins.

How does Mozart compare with Glimpse and HighRadius?

All three address deduction-management workflows, and their public materials describe overlapping automation capabilities. Compare retailer coverage, evidence traceability, approval controls, accounting connections, and quoted commercial terms for your specific business.

Are recoveries guaranteed?

No. Outcomes depend on the claim, supporting evidence, retailer requirements, and deadlines. The recovery calculator is an illustrative scenario, not a promise.

Who can we contact?

Email start@mozart.financial or schedule a call to discuss your workflow. Response commitments and your day-to-day contact are established in your service arrangement.
